a.lede: You probably don't think about your iPad charging until it runs into trouble. When plugging it in doesn't work, you'll need to check its port and charger.
a.title: Why is your iPad not charging (and how to fix it)

b.lede: Wireless charging offers convenience, to be sure, but how does it affect your battery over time? And is it a problem if your phone heats up?
b.title: Wired vs. wireless charging: Which is better for battery health?
